findings.correction: System-file parsing and direct construction share one endpoint canonicalizer. Deduplication compares canonical scopes, so equivalent spellings cannot consume distinct server slots.
findings.proof: A temporary resolv.conf contains eight spellings of scope 1 followed by a distinct IPv4 resolver. Baseline retained eight duplicate endpoints and omitted the final resolver; correction retains the two distinct endpoints. This is configuration behavior proof, not a claim of DNS traffic to the documentation address.

findings.correction: Private address-family results carry optional live nameserver provenance. Cross-family canonical conflicts use the live result peer, including when either family came from cache. Cached-only conflicts do not invent a current remote response. Public ResolveResult and query signatures remain unchanged.
findings.proof: Owned UDP responses provide different A and AAAA canonical names. Separate cache states prewarm each family; both mixed live/cache conflicts retain the peer. Repeating each lookup from cache still rejects the conflict without a remote endpoint.
